title: New law: Rehabilitation Act Amendments of 1974 (Public Law 93-651)
summary: H.R. 14225 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-651 on 1974-11-26.

title: New law: A bill to eliminate discrimination based on sex in the youth programs offered by the Naval Sea Cadet Corps. (Public Law 93-504)
summary: S. 3204 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-504 on 1974-11-29.

title: New law: A bill to amend the Communications Act of 1934, as amended, to permit the Federal Communications Commission to grant radio station licenses in the safety and special and experimental radio services directly to aliens, representatives of aliens, foreign corporations, or domestic corporations with alien officers, directors, or stockholders; and to permit aliens holding such radio station licenses to be licensed as operators. (Public Law 93-505)
summary: S. 2457 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-505 on 1974-11-30.

title: New law: A bill to amend subsection (b) of section 214 and subsection (c)(1) of section 222 of the Communications Act of 1934, as amended, in order to designate the Secretary of Defense (rather than the Secretaries of the Army and the Navy) as the person entitled to receive official notice of the filing of certain applications in the common carrier service and to provide notice to the Secretary of State where under section 214 applications involve service to foreign points. (Public Law 93-506)
summary: S. 1479 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-506 on 1974-11-30.

title: New law: A bill to amend section 415 of the Communications Act of 1934, as amended, to provide for a two-year period of limitations in proceedings against carriers for the recovery of overcharges or damages not based on overcharges. (Public Law 93-507)
summary: S. 1227 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-507 on 1974-11-30.

title: New law: National Mass Transportation Assistance Act of 1974 (Public Law 93-503)
summary: S. 386 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-503 on 1974-11-26.

title: New law: A bill to amend section 552 of title 5, United States Code, known as the Freedom of Information Act. (Public Law 93-502)
summary: H.R. 12471 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-502 on 1974-11-21.
